title: The Berry Bowl by Chubby Juice E -Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
The Berry Bowl Shortfill E-Liquid:
Dive into a luscious medley of ripe strawberry, tangy pineapple, and a blend of mixed berries, all brought together with a hint of sweetness and a refreshing icy finish. This perfectly balanced combination delivers a burst of fruity freshness that’s both invigorating and smooth. With each puff, discover the harmony of tropical and berry notes mingling with a cool, crisp sensation, making it an ideal choice for fans of vibrant, layered flavours.
Product Features
Brand:
Chubby Juice
Brand Origin:
UK
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavored E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free.
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine shots have been added –
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
